Is that clear? BOTH: Yes, sir!

entries.text: Deputy Director Kersh.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: I'm gonna ask you once and only once. Where is he?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Sir, of whom are we speaking? Cut the crap, agents.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Have you ever wondered why... ...After 35 years in the Bureau... ...Walter Skinner isn't sitting on this side of the desk... ...Or even perhaps running this whole damn agency, for that matter?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Are you looking for Skinner?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Let me be unambiguous... ...In the event that there are any questions about this in your conspiracy-addled minds. Walter Skinner's stalled career... ...Nas everything to do with his blind loyalty to the both of you... ...And your misguided search for some imaginary truth.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Sir, what is this about?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: Skinner's gone AWOL, Agent Mulder, without warning or explanation. And, frankly, I don't buy your naivete, not even a moment. He hasn't been the same since the two of you returned to the Bureau. Sir, has anyone checked his apartment? Could he have had a medical emergency? The director's asking questions about Skinner's activities that I can't answer. There's some implication that he recently started poking around... ...IN places he shouldn't be poking.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: What sort of places?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: I couldn't say. But tf you truly care about his future in the FBI... ...I suggest you bring him back here while he still has a future to return to.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh
entries.location: Int. Kersh’S Office - Fbi Headquarters - Day Le

entries.text: What happened to the old reliable Skinner we knew and loved?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Hallway - Skinner'S Apartment Building - Day

entries.text: Well, based on his behavior the past couple months... .. It's safe to say the old Skinner has left the building.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Hallway - Skinner'S Apartment Building - Day

entries.text: Mulder, do you think his disappearance actually has to do with us? Or something to do with William or that business with the Purlieu Services?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Hallway - Skinner'S Apartment Building - Day

entries.text: There's no way of telling what Skinner's been up to recently. But I'll Keep my eyes peeled for cigarette butts.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Hallway - Skinner'S Apartment Building - Day

entries.text: Maybe he's out meeting with an interior decorator.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: No, I noticed this the last time that we were here. There are no personal items. No mementos, no knickknacks... ...NoO family photographs. It occurs to me that even after all these years... ...We know precious little about Walter Sergei Skinner beyond the professional. It appears he may suffer from moderate to severe constipation. I'm sorry to be a wimp, Mulder, but this just feels wrong. This feels like a real invasion of his privacy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Well, it's not like Skinner to just disappear without telling anyone. You know? As much as I dont trust the guy right now... ...If he’s gotten into a dangerous situation, he's gonna forgive us this little trespass.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Look at this, Mulder. “Lance Corporal Walter Skinner. Third Battalion, Third Marines, United States Marine Corps." That's a peculiar way to address It. There's no return address.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Aah!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Is that a--? Desiccated human ear. There's a note. “The monsters are here." Monsters, Mulder. Does that get your juices flowing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: As much as I appreciate any reference to my juices, Scully... ...My only concern here is for Skinner. But now I'm worried about him.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Me, too.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: “The Mud Lick Messenger."
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Mud Lick?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Skinner’S Apartment - Continuous

entries.text: Well, this is strange. Based on the way that package was addressed... ...I requested some basic information about Skinner and his platoon in Vietnam... ... Like names of his fellow Marines, et cetera... Uh-huh. ...And I've just received word that I've been denied access by the Bureau. That the information is classified top secret.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully’S Car - Day - Highway - Moving

entries.text: Well, the sheriff here in Mud Lick says he's got a body in the morgue minus an ear. I'll bet you that that victim turns out to be one of Skinner's platoon mates... ...From that classified list.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully’S Car - Day - Highway - Moving

entries.text: You ain't gonna find no kitten. What? Ain't no kitten out there.

entries.text: No. All right.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Doctor Matthew Wegweiser. The victim was a medical doctor?
entries.speaker: Sheriff
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: That's correct, ma‘am. Doc Wegweiser Is-- Was our one and only town doctor.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Terrific guy. Beloved.
entries.speaker: Sheriff
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Went out for a hike Thursday last, never to return.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Mrs. Wegweiser told us he hiked the same route several times a week.
entries.speaker: Sheriff
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: We found him on the trail, got himself snared in some kind of hunting trap.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: A hunting trap? How do you account for the severed ear?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Well, I can't, honestly. And the missing teeth? Missing teeth? The autopsy says that he was missing... ... Several upper and lower molars ...and a couple of bicuspids. But there's no evidence of advanced tooth decay or periodontitis. No evidence of manual extraction.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: That mean something to you?
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: It's funny because I just happened to have lost two teeth in the past month myself. And my wife lost one yesterday. We were puzzling over it at breakfast.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Hmm.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: The autopsy also says that there were wood splinters inside the wound. This hunting trap, did it have some kind of a spear or stake element?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Yes, ma’‘am. It was a primitive whip trap. It's a bent piece of bamboo held by a trip wire. There's a sharpened spear attached at the end.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: It's a punji stick. Pardon? It's a simple spear made of wood or bamboo. It was used in Vietnam in any one of a number of insidious traps or weapons. Was Dr. Wegweiser here by any chance a Vietnam vet?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: I don't believe he was, no.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Are there any other Vietnam vets in town that you know of?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Oh, sure. Yeah, there's an institution outside of town called Glazebrook. Lot of guys were sent up there after the war. Lot of them stuck around when they got out. I think we passed one on our way in. Old Trigger Davis. He's harmless.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Trigger? Is Glazebrook a mental hospital? Right, ma'am, a government-run facility. I'd like to see a list of past and current patients. Do you have access to that?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Probably not. They run a tight ship up there. But I'll see what I can drum up. Thank you, sheriff. Anything to dispel the craziness everyone in town is buzzing about.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: What kind of craziness is that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: People are swearing they seen some kind of monster out in the woods.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Hmm.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Mud Lick Morgue - Day

entries.text: Well, Banjo called me up and said he saw a damn monster out here in his woods... ...And could I come with him and look around. We was having that look around when he just straight disappeared.

entries.text: Did you say Banjo?

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Well, first he thought it was a bear, shh, shh, shh, but then he saw big old horns. And it was walking on two feet. Same as people in town was talking about.
entries.speaker: Hillbilly Ed
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: But Mr. Krager, I mean, Banjo, was he a Vietnam vet?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Yeah, he was.
entries.speaker: Hillbilly Ed
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: This may seem like an odd question, but was he missing any teeth?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Yeah, he was. He'd just keep losing them, like he’s an old man or something. Well, I can't make much fun of him because I been losing some, too.
entries.speaker: Hillbilly Ed
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: What's this?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: That's, uh, that's one of them deer cams.
entries.speaker: Hillbilly Ed
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Hunters use them for game surveillance. They send an alert to your phone when they detect movement.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Can we review what's on it? Should be able to see it on a computer back at the station. Something about that camera that's troubling you, sir?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: Banjo don't have no deer cams.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: I mean, at least none that I seen, and I hunt with him, like, every week.
entries.speaker: Hillbilly Ed
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: The camera is motion activated...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Hunter’S Pit - Woods - Day

entries.text: ...So It shouldn't take terribly long to find what we're looking for.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Oh.
entries.speaker: Dana
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: There.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: I don't believe it.
entries.speaker: Sheriff
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: There's our killer. Why do I get the distinct feeling you two know who that man Is? That how it's gonna be? I've been nothing but courteous to y'all, and I don't appreciate being played a fool. Excuse me. I gotta go tell my people we found their monster.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Sheriff, that man is our boss. Assistant Director Walter Skinner of the FBI.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Well, what in the hell was he doing at my crime scene last night?
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: That's what we're here to find out.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: You're telling me you knew that man was here all along?
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Walter Skinner didn't do this. He's a good man. He's a smart man. He's been at the FBI for over 30 years, and this murder's sloppy. I mean, not that he's capable of murder. But if he was, he certainly wouldn't get himself caught on camera at a crime scene.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: So tell me, what's your good man doing... ... Standing over a dead body in the woods in the middle of the night? A body which he neglected to call in to any law enforcement agency... ...Including his own?
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Well, I Know it looks bad, sheriff, but I assure you, he’s not your man.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: You can assure me all you want. "I'll decide who my man is... ...When I get a chance to bring him in and have a conversation with him. Now, if you'll excuse me, I gotta go put out an APB for this Walter Skinner.
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: There's more on that tape, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Put down an out all-points bulletin for a Walter Skinner, white male, glasses....
entries.speaker: Sheriff Stenzler
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: Hurry up. You're gonna get us run out of town.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: --armed and dangerous.
entries.speaker: Sheriff
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: [BEEPING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Police Station - Shortly After

entries.text: What did we just see, Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Police Station - Shortly After - Day

entries.text: We find that monster, we find Skinner.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Police Station - Shortly After - Day

entries.text: Tell me you dont think that was some real, actual monster we just saw.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Police Station - Shortly After - Day

entries.text: For once, we agree. Monsters don't dig pits and set traps. That was a man in a mask. I'm more concerned about Skinner's state of mind right now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Police Station - Shortly After - Day

entries.text: [[NDISTINCT CHATTERING]

entries.text: Maybe Skinner's experiencing a delayed form of PTSD from his time in Vietnam. That's, uh, not without precedent. And even the shock of receiving that ear in the mail is a pretty plausible trigger.

entries.text: What? You said trigger. Trigger. Banjo.

entries.text: John, is that you?

entries.text: Your father and I, heh, we went through a lot together.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: Calls you baby killer.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: Where is your father, Davey?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: Father says it's your fault the way our life turned out. Because of your testimony against him after the war... ...Father spent 38 years in Glazebrook.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: Until I got a letter from him last week, I thought he was dead. I soent years searching for him after his trial, but they vanished him. His records were sealed, even from me. Who vanished him? The same people responsible for turning him from the good man he was into....
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: Into what?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: I only wanna help him.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: I'm sorry, I don't believe he wants your help, Walter Skinner. Father told me all the stories about his time in Vietnam.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day

entries.text: There were monsters in that jungle. Because of his exposure to an experimental weaponized gas....
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Vietnamese Village - Day (1969)

entries.text: [YELLING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Vietnamese Village - Day (1969)

entries.text: He wasn't crazy like you said at his court-martial, but no one believed him. Not even Mother. No one except me.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: Listen, Davey, I know what he saw.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: I got a glimpse of it myself, but it wasn't real.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: It was the gas using his own fear against him. Your dad was exposed to a lot more of it than I was, and it changed him.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: I watched it happen. And yet, you said nothing about that gas at his trial?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: Did you?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: They'd let me visit him sometimes up at Glazebrook.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: I had to sign all manner of non-disclosure documents.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: Do you realize how painful it was for me... ...To see my father wasting away at that sanitarium?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: They kept him behind glass the whole time. I couldn't even touch him. I couldn't touch my own father.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Visitation Room - Psychiatric Hospital - Flashback(2017)

entries.text: How could you let that happen to your friend?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: I was forbidden to speak about the gas at his court-martial. I was following orders, doing what my superiors commanded me to do.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: I'm not saying it's right. It's not.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: And I have lived with the guilt of that decision every moment since. I think about him every day. But you gotta understand, your dad murdered innocent people. And I Know it was because of the gas. I Knew who he was before. But the man it changed him into.... He was dangerous, Davey.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: People are getting hurt again, and we can stop it.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: But you've got to believe that I am here to help him. I only wanna make things right.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: Please... ... Take me to him, Davey. Okay. I'll take you to him.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: His name is John "Kitten" James.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: He is or was, in fact, a patient at Glazebrook Hospital.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Day (Present Day)

entries.text: But his military files, like the other files I've tried to access, are classified.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder & Scully’S Car - Road - Moving - Day

entries.text: You think it's true, Scully, what Kersh said? What's that? That we're the sole reason Skinner's career hasn't advanced in 30-some years?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mulder & Scully’S Car - Road - Moving - Day

entries.text: I hope not. I'd like to believe that his choice to stay loyal to us was exactly that, a choice. But if there's one thing I know about Walter Skinner... ...IS he's a man ruled by his moral compass above all else.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder & Scully’S Car - Road - Moving - Day

entries.text: There was a time I would have agreed with that unequivocally.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mulder & Scully’S Car - Road - Moving - Day

entries.text: I realize that his conduct has been strange... ...Out don't you think we should give him the benefit of the doubt... ...After everything we've been through? I mean, especially in light of wnat we now understand he may have sacrificed for us. Let's just hope we find him before somebody else does.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder & Scully’S Car - Road - Moving - Day

entries.text: Where are we going, Davey?
entries.speaker: Walter
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: It's not far now.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: This is what they drove him to. Oh, God. No, John, what have you done?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: John.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: [GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: [GASPING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: Now who sees monsters?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: Help me! Is somebody out there? Help!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: Why ?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: No!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Night

entries.text: Can I help you? Special Agent Mulder. Special Agent Dana Scully. Are you related to John James? I'm his son, Davey.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: We're looking for a man who we believe may be in the area... ..And may have served with your father in Vietnam. Walter Skinner.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: I don't believe I've heard that name before, no. Is your father home? No, I'm sorry. I haven't a clue where he is. I haven't seen him in weeks.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: Is it okay if we come inside for a brief moment?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: We'd like to get some insight on a few things. By all means.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: Right this way.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: [GASPING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: [GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: [GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: Help! I've never met real live FBI agents before.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: Please.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Night - Continuous

entries.text: Father said there's two refuges in life from sorrow... ...MUSIC... ...And cats. But I think cats are creepy.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: [JOHN CALE'S "FEAR IS A MAN'S BEST FRIEND" PLAYING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Can I offer you some tea or something? No, no, I'm good. No, thank you.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Um.... Mr. James, we understand that your father was a patient at Glazebrook?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Yes, uh, that's right. For many years. And when was he released? He was released one month ago.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: On what grounds? Sorry? Why was he released after he had been confined for so many years?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: They determined that he was no longer a danger to himself or anyone else. Not that he ever was. Well, I guess he was a threat to someone.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Is this your mother?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: My mother died many years ago. Father's incarceration was very hard on her.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Do you mind if I ask how she died? Yes.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Mr. James, a minute ago you said that your father was a threat to someone.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: What did you mean? Father had secrets. Secrets? About the government. Father was poisoned by an experimental weaponized gas in Vietnam.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Because of his exposure, they continued to do tests on him... ..And other soldiers for many years at Glazebrook.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cell - Psychiatric Hospital - Day (1980S)

entries.text: What kind of tests? Chemical and biological.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45A

entries.text: They were trying to learn how to control human behavior. Harnessing our fears to manipulate us into violence.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cell - Psychiatric Hospital - Day (1980S) 45B

entries.text: [GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cell - Psychiatric Hospital - Day (1980S) 45B

entries.text: Using this weaponized gas?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: The gas in the war was still in the experimental stage. And they still haven't perfected it. But after years of testing it and honing it... ... They are getting close. To what end? Imagine the power of a government that could literally control the minds... ...Of millions of its citizens. Influence every choice and decision they made simply by exposing them to this poison.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: You'll have to forgive me, Mr. James, but this sounds like a dystopian novel.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: It's happening right now in the United States of America. Do you honestly believe that after 30 years of research and development... ..And decades of experimenting on American heroes like my father... ...They would just be thrown in the trash? Never to be utilized?
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: Unlikely. The DoD and the CIA have been working on various incarnations... ...Of mind-control projects since the '50s.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: Project Bluebird, MK-ULTRA, MK-DELTA.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: Well, those programs were supposedly ended in the early 1980s.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: Supposedly.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: My father believed he was part of the program MK-NAOMI...
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: ...Which was a successor to MK-ULTRA.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: We don't know how they're using this chemical now, but we know that they are. Maybe they're poisoning our water or the food supply. Maybe they're putting it in those chemtrails behind all those commercial jets... ...That fly over our country every single day.
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: Thank you, Sir. Thank you, Mr. James.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: [MUSIC CONTINUES PLAYING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Night 45C

entries.text: You drive. What's going on, Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Let's just get in the car and drive away.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Mulder, you wanna tell me what's going on?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully'S Car - Dirt Driveway - Moving - Night

entries.text: He claims not to know who Skinner is, but in the photo album...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully'S Car - Dirt Driveway - Moving - Night

entries.text: ... There were photos of his dad and Skinner like they were BFFs.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully'S Car - Dirt Driveway - Moving - Night

entries.text: And did you check out that SUV parked beside the cabin?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully'S Car - Dirt Driveway - Moving - Night

entries.text: Yeah, that definitely wasn't his. Skinner could be back there. Then why the hell are we driving away? Just pull over here.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mulder And Scully'S Car - Dirt Driveway - Moving - Night

entries.text: Get somewhere with cell reception, call the sheriff... ..And get every available officer down here.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: What are you gonna do?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: I'm gonna do for Skinner what I'd hope he would do for us.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: [MUSIC CONTINUES PLAYING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: [MUSIC CONTINUES PLAYING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Help!
entries.speaker: Walter
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Help!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Come on.
entries.speaker: Walter
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Damn it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Is somebody out there?
entries.speaker: Walter
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Hello?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Mulder? Skinner.
entries.speaker: Walter
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: [PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Dirt Road - Woods - Mulder And Scully’S Car - Night

entries.text: Get me the hell out of here.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: [GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: "I'll boost you up. I'll boost you, you're good. Here we go.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Ext. Backyard - Cabin In The Woods - Continuous

entries.text: Davey. Davey, please. Let us out.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Let's do this quickly. Come on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [WALTER GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Gas. Ugh. Davey. You don't have to do this.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [GUNSHOT]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Scully. Where's Davey?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Go. Go!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [GROANS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [GRUNTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [DANA GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [WALTER PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: [DANA SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Pit - Night

entries.text: Ambulance is on its way. I would call Kersh as soon as you get cell reception. Something you wanna share?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: Kersh indicated to us that we were responsible... ...For your lack of upward mobility in the Bureau. If it wasn't for you two, I wouldn't be here right now.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: And I'm not talking about the fact that you showed up here today.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: I enlisted in the Marine Corps the day that I turned 18.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: I was a kid.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: Full of callow self-confidence, and faith, and this....
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: This kind of uncorrupted belief that I was doing the right thing. But John James...
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: ...Ne didn't enlist.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: He was drafted.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: And his whole life was completely upended...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: ...Oy a war that he really, truly didn't even understand.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: And he was so afraid all the time. I felt like I had to protect him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: But I didn't.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: I couldn't.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: That experience in Vietnam with John... ..It put a dent in that blind faith that I had in my government. It planted seeds of mistrust. I tried for years to suppress that mistrust, but it gnawed at me.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: [SCOFFS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: Then you two. You two came along and you taught me not to hide from it... ...0ut to have the guts to shine a light directly into the darkest corners. And if given the choice between advancing my career... ...By being blindly loyal to some faceless puppeteers pulling strings from the shadows... ...Or to throw in with you two, make no mistake about It... ...I'd make the same decision every single damn time. So I'm gonna go back, I'm gonna kiss the ring. But I intend to do right by this man... ...And that means finding the truth of what the hell it was they used him for. No matter the cost. I owe him that.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: [SCOFFS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: I owe myself that.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: [GROANS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: Skinner. We're with you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: Imagine the power of a government that can literally control the minds...
entries.speaker: Davey James
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: ...Of millions and millions of its citizens, simply by exposing them to this poison.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning

entries.text: It's happening. It's happening right now.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Int. Cabin In The Woods - Morning
